records.text: Mossad knew in advance about the 1982 bombing of U.S. Marines in Lebanon, including when it would happen and the van involved, but withheld the information.

verification.notes: By Way of Deception did allege that Mossad had advance intelligence about a large Mercedes truck being prepared for an attack and passed only a general warning to the United States. verification.notes: Transcript claims a helipad was built and archaeological material entered sandbags. The British Museum damage assessment and contemporaneous reporting document a helicopter landing area and sandbags/earthworks containing ancient pottery, brick, and other archaeological fragments.

records.text: U.S. forces were at Babylon to plunder, loot, and steal, not to protect ancient ruins.

verification.notes: Transcript context distinguishes alleged motive from documented damage.
